🧪 How online play & the AI work
  • Online today: rollback lockstep is the shipped mode — both devices run the full match simulation and only tick-stamped card plays cross the wire, so a jittery relay can't make the two screens disagree. A build-version handshake opens every room, a state-hash check runs the whole match, and if a desync is ever detected the match falls back to host-streamed interpolation for that match only (and says so in the battle log). PvE vs AI runs fully offline — no relay needed.
  • Rollback gate: rollback shipped only because two independent sims fed the same tick-stamped inputs stay state-hash identical for whole matches — including when those inputs arrive jittery, reordered and spiked past 200ms (delivery order must not matter; tick stamps decide). The test below re-runs that proof in this page, on the real sim code.
  • Determinism: not run yet on this device.
  • AI training: benchmark summary loads with the page.

Collection — tap to swap in

Tap a deck slot, then tap any card to swap it in — selection auto-advances to the next slot. Cards already in the deck are outlined green; tapping one swaps its slot with the selected slot. Bot decks: archetype rolls, Shuffle and AI Pool never deal Berserker OP automatically — he only gets in when you place him by hand, exactly like the clone.
